versions.changelog:
Agnes Video Generator 1.0.0

- Initial release with support for AI-generated videos using the Agnes-Video-V2.0 model.
- Supports text-to-video and image-to-video animation.
- Allows multi-image and keyframe animation via script extension.
- Handles asynchronous video generation with automatic polling.
- Returns direct video URL upon completion.
- Supports adjustable frame count, frame rate, resolution, random seed, and negative prompts.
